symbolic.conservation: J=-q*sum(w*H(t-delay))/(N*a); w=2*mu_surface*dmu_surface; q=G*L_infinity/c^5. Body debit=-q*H(t), photon energy inside r=q*(H(t)-sum(w*H(t-delay))).
symbolic.trace: -E+Pr+2*Pt=0 does not remove metric-mediated scalar forcing.
symbolic.boundary: For a steady outgoing isotropic hemisphere E=2F/[c(1+mu_min)] and Pr=2F*(1+mu_min+mu_min^2)/[3c(1+mu_min)]; mu_min^2=1-N(r)^2/(N_surface^2*r^2).
